last_change.summary: Added the target-node CPU architecture requirement (Node.architecture) with its governed vocabulary, aliases, and governed x-<owner>:<term> extension for issue #674; the schema constrains the value to that governed vocabulary (no unrestricted string branch), keeps target/package/host architecture distinct, and defines fail-closed target/runtime-package compatibility, including the ADR-061 tightening that a node without a target architecture may not carry an architecture-constrained package.
